description_en: Downloads the query diagnostic information of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 下载AnalyticDB PostgreSQL的实例的查询诊断记录
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb download-diagnosis-records --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --database adbtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DownloadDiagnosisRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition on queries. The value is in the JSON format. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`: filters the top 100 queries that are the most time-consuming.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: filters completed queries.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`: filters running queries.
`{"Type":"cost","Max":"200"}`: filters the queries that consume less than 200 milliseconds.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"200","Max":"60000"}`: filters the queries that consume 200 milliseconds or more and less than 1 minute.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"60000"}`: filters the queries that consume 1 minute or more.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`: filters the queries that consume 30 milliseconds or more and less than 50 milliseconds. You can customize a filter condition by setting Min and Max
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，JSON格式，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`：耗时最长的100个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：已完成的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`：运行中的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Max":"200"}`：短耗时查询，执行耗时小于200毫秒的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"200","Max":"60000"}`：中等耗时查询，执行耗时大于等于200毫秒且小于1分钟的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"60000"}`：长耗时查询，执行耗时大于等于1分钟的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`：自定义耗时查询，您可以自定义设置查询的最短耗时和最长耗时，Min表示最短耗时；Max表示最长耗时，单位为毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en:
The language of the file that contains the query diagnostic information. Valid values:

zh: simplified Chinese
en: English
ja: Japanese
zh-tw: traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
下载文件的语言，取值如下：

zh：简体中文。
en：英文。
ja：日语。
zh-tw：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DownloadId.description_en: The ID of the download task
